PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: docks the test's taxi cab and writes the masses the server has for it
PluginData.Description: Test only. Puts a piston head and a wheel on the "Taxi Mass Cab" grid, locks its connectors to the "TM Station" and "TM Parked" grids, and writes the cab's masses, the taxi pickup offer's among them, to cab-mass-probe.txt in the game's user data folder.
